author: artlbv
body:
#### PR description:

`l1tCaloJetHTT` in `L1Trigger/Configuration/python/SimL1Emulator_cff.py` reads `("L1CaloJet", "CaloJets")`. No module produces that product: the producer is `l1tCaloJet` (`L1CaloJetProducer`), and its jet output is a `BXVector<l1t::Jet>` with instance `L1CaloJetCollectionBXV`. The HTT producer checks `isValid()` and skips missing input, so the CaloJet HTT is silently 0 in every event. The label looks like a leftover from the `l1t` renaming of the Phase-2 L1 cfis.

This PR changes the input to `("l1tCaloJet", "L1CaloJetCollectionBXV")`. `l1tCaloJetHTT` is only written to the event content; nothing in the release reads it (P2GT, Phase-2 HLT, DQM), so no other output changes.

#### PR validation:

- `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre1`, 5 locally generated TTbar Run4D110 events (wf 29634.0 step1/step2): re-ran the HTT producer with the fixed tag on the step2 output and compared it with HT summed directly from `l1tCaloJet:L1CaloJetCollectionBXV` (pT  30, ||  2.4):

| event | HTT current | HTT fixed | manual sum |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.0 | 414.1 | 414.1 |
| 1 | 0.0 | 109.8 | 109.8 |
| 2 | 0.0 | 68.5 | 68.5 |
| 3 | 0.0 | 76.2 | 76.2 |
| 4 | 0.0 | 65.3 | 65.3 |

- `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-05-2300` with this branch: the cmsDriver configuration of wf 38434.0 step2 (`DIGI:pdigi_valid,L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT`, Run4D128) builds, and `l1tCaloJetHTT` reads `l1tCaloJet:L1CaloJetCollectionBXV`, which is produced in the same process.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport. Backport to `CMSSW_17_1_X`: #52468
title: [L1T Phase-2] Fix input tag of l1tCaloJetHTT
